name: mm-drive
description: Ultragoal/Ralph-style outer drive loop for the single mm-delivery pipeline. No gjc/omc/omx/hermes. Merge only after independent APPROVE + green + no critical blockers (user directive).

merge_policy.note: Human GH APPROVE is NOT mandatory. Cross-model dual-critic packet with admit verdicts + oya-ci-required SUCCESS clears merge. Self-approve GH reviews still never count. Original harness: Grok orchestrates, dual CRITIC independence, not merge authority without CI.

classes.resolvable: CI red fixable, open kit slice, missing local verify, or merge_ready PR to execute — block Stop and continue
classes.waiting_ci: Checks pending after push — default allow Stop (avoid thrash)
classes.human_blocked: Awaiting independent APPROVE, secrets, or ratify — allow Stop
classes.merge_ready: APPROVE + oya-ci-required green + no critical blockers — agent may squash-merge
classes.idle_complete: Terminal evidence recorded for that story — allow Stop
classes.sequenced_blocked: Gated on another story (e.g. W0-B after G001) — allow Stop
classes.unknown: Could not re-query — allow Stop fail-soft
